summary: Tested Boosted Combos (API + UI) plus UFC/betting regressions. Backend: 20/20 pytest passed (new test_boosts.py has 9 tests, test_ufc_cards_league_odds.py has 11). GET /api/boosts returns 3 boosts in tier order botd/boosted/golden. Each has 3 legs (moneyline, total, prop) from one pre-game event, and base and boosted odds match the formula exactly (e.g. 1.29*1.69*2.0 gives base 3.15 and boosted 3.47). A boost bet via POST /api/bets returns 200 with total_odds equal to the boosted odds, boost meta stored, the balance deducted and the bet persisted. A fake boost_id, a partial set of legs, or another boost's legs all return 409 with boost_gone=true; no auth returns 401. Normal single and parlay bets still work (boost=null, parlay odds equal base). UI: the strip renders 3 cards with tier pill, countdown (ticks every second), league, date, matchup, 3 legs with connector dots, and struck base » boosted odds. Clicking boost-add-<tier> fills the slip with 3 legs, shows the banner, matching combined odds and the struck base, hides the single/parlay toggle, highlights the active card and computes payout correctly (10 x 4.09 = 40.89). Switching to another boost replaces the slip. Removing a leg clears the boost. A logged-in boost bet placed 2 USDT at 5.57 ('Bet placed!', header balance down $2). A boost_gone 409 (simulated with route interception) shows a warning toast and clears the banner. Mobile 390: the strip scrolls sideways with no page overflow; the slip drawer shows the boost. UFC: MAIN EVENT and FEATURED BOUT labels both appear; mobile bout rows are readable (name, flag, record, 'To Win' button). No page errors.

minor.issue: build_boosts drops events starting within 5 min, but the frontend card only hides at 0. In the last 5 minutes the card still shows, and placing it returns 409 boost_gone. Also, boosts are rebuilt from the live cache on every call. A boost can disappear mid-session (boost_gone) if a cache refresh changes which side is favorite or which prop is closest to 2.0.

ui_bugs.issue: setBoost(null) runs before the conflict check. Clicking a conflicting pick (e.g. total-over on the boost event that already has Under) is rejected, but the boost is still silently cleared. Reproduced: added the botd boost, clicked odds-button-<botd>-total-over; the slip still had the same 3 legs, the banner was gone and odds showed x3 singles.

When a boost is cleared (leg removed, a pick added, or a 409 boost_gone), the slip goes back to mode 'single' (the default state), not parlay. The 3 boost legs become 'Place 3 Bets' singles, and the total stake triples. The boost_gone toast says 'picks still on slip at regular odds', which suggests a parlay. Expected per spec: odds revert to a normal parlay. Fix: setMode('parlay') in loadSlip/when a boost is set, or keep parlay mode when the boost is cleared.

issues: Prop leg text is cut off on desktop cards ('Ausar Thompson O32.5 Fantasyscore - Play…'). Consider a 2-line clamp or dropping the market suffix for props.
Card order is BOTD, BOOSTED, GOLDEN; the reference/request listed BOTD, GOLDEN, BOOSTED (cosmetic).
'Fantasyscore' stat label looks unpolished (should be 'Fantasy Score').
With a 3-leg boost, the legs area is very short: the 3rd leg is cut off behind the summary panel and needs an inner scroll.

action_items: BetSlipContext.addSelection: only clear the boost when the slip actually changes (not on a rejected conflict or a no-op)
When a boost is cleared or boost_gone, switch the slip to parlay mode (or set mode='parlay' in loadSlip) so the legs stay a combo instead of turning into N singles

Make the card countdown hide/disable at starts_at minus 5 min to match the backend cutoff, and consider keying boost validity on a stable id/legs snapshot so cache refreshes don't randomly invalidate a boost
Minor: prop leg truncation on cards; mobile slip legs area height
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2400+ lines; split the boosts, betting and odds modules

place_bet: the boost branch recomputes total_odds from verified live prices (good), but the pct comes from the server boost (good). Note there is no stake cap per the user's choice, so boosted payouts are unlimited.
build_boosts is called synchronously on every /api/boosts and every boost bet; fine for now (small cache)
seed_data_creation: Placed small test bets on the admin account: 1 USDT boost parlay, 1 USDT single and 1 USDT parlay via pytest; 2 USDT boost bet via the UI
